faq.title: FAQ
faq.more: All questions on the services page →

items.a: A landing page usually takes 1–2 weeks, a company website 4–6 weeks, a web app from 6 weeks. I give an exact timeline after the brief.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: “From” prices are on the services page and in the calculator. The final price depends on scope and is fixed in the contract before work starts.

items.q: How does payment work, and is there a contract?
items.a: Yes, I always work under a contract that fixes the scope, timeline and price — so both sides are protected. Payment is split in half: 50% before the start, 50% after delivery and your acceptance. I divide larger projects into phases, and you accept and pay for each phase separately — you only pay for the next one once you are happy with the previous one. Revisions within the agreed scope are included in the price. Companies receive a proper invoice and an acceptance certificate.

items.q: What do you need from me to start?
items.a: A description of the task, examples of websites you like, existing texts and photos, and access to your domain or hosting if you already have them.

items.q: Who owns the code and domain?
items.a: You do: domain, hosting and analytics are registered to you, and the source code is handed over after payment.
Yes, I am based in Hannover and work remotely with clients from Germany, Russia and other countries: calls, messengers, shared access to the test version.

extra.q: Can you improve an existing website?
extra.a: Yes. I review the code and infrastructure first, then propose improving or rebuilding — with an estimate for both options.
Dependency updates, backups, uptime monitoring and small changes. Scope and price as agreed.
Enquiries from Germany are processed under GDPR; enquiries from Russia are stored on a server in Russia (152-FZ).
